messages:
Maya (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's AH — dropping a thread for the finance/procurement questions. @Owen will take Qs and @Nate will follow up on procurement ops. Please keep questions short and we'll answer here.
Owen (CFO): TL;DR — runway is ~15 months under current plan, targeted reductions in discretionary spend to extend to ~18 months if we hit hiring/contractor pauses and procurement changes.
Priya (Product): Thanks. Can you confirm whether hiring pauses affect previously approved offers?
Owen (CFO): Offers already signed remain honored. We are pausing new reqs and re-evaluating open roles before extending new offers; managers with critical needs can request an exception via the approvals form.
Sam (Eng): What's the new threshold for manager approvals vs. procurement tickets? I have a $4k GPU accessory purchase pending.
Nate (Procurement): New rule starting next Monday: any spend >= $3,000 requires a procurement ticket and a manager + finance reviewer approval. <$3,000 can be approved by manager but should use the P-Card where available.
Jordan (Finance): Quick note on reserved capacity/contracts — committed infra (Dedicated) renewals require finance pre-notification 45 days before renewal so we can evaluate usage and negotiate terms. If you have renewal notices, please forward to finance@redwood.com.
Riley (People Ops): For contractors already in flight, is there a cutoff date for extensions?
Owen (CFO): Contractors with active SOWs through end of quarter stand. Any extensions must be routed through People Ops + finance review. Exceptions are narrow and need chief approval.
Priya (Product): Where do we find the approvals matrix and the new ticket form?
Nate (Procurement): Link: https://intranet.redwood/procurement/approval-matrix — procurement ticket form: https://intranet.redwood/procurement/new-ticket (internal only). Fill 'Business justification' and 'Cost center'.
Sam (Eng): Example cost center for runtime infra?
Jordan (Finance): Use `GL: 425-RUNTIME-2026` for infra spend for now. If uncertain, include proposed GL in the ticket and finance will map it.
finance-bot: Reminder — all P-Card transactions will be audited monthly; non-compliant charges will be flagged to managers.
Maya (CEO): Appreciate the clarity. Two action items: (1) Finance/Procurement to publish an FAQ by EOD Friday, (2) Managers to audit active contractor spend this week and flag anything needing extension.
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup: noted — I'll audit our team's contractors.
Priya (Product): Thanks Owen/Nate — will route any urgent vendor onboards through you.
Owen (CFO): Final — if you're planning a >$10k vendor commitment, loop in @Owen and @Nate early. We'll triage. For any one-off emergency spends, tag #finance-emergency and include justification; approvals are ad hoc.
Maya (CEO): Closing — feel free to DM for anything sensitive. We'll keep updates coming as we track savings. :white_check_mark:
note: Thread contains internal budget and procurement clarifications from All-Hands Q&A. Messages are in chronological order and use Slack-style short replies and links.
